positiveContract.rationale: T2 (tool-corroborated) and T3 (project policy) have no provider-documented ground truth to certify against, and T0 has no positive at all; only a T1 contract, backed by providerSource, counts.

minimumTwinPairs.rationale: Five discriminated positive/negative twin pairs is the minimum sample that the detector reliably tells the credential apart from a near-identical non-secret.

twinFailures.rationale: A twin failure is a recorded false negative on the exact discrimination this project exists to make; stable tolerates none, however small the sample.

minimumCases.rationale: Five benign controls is the minimum sample to claim the detector stays quiet on adjacent, non-secret shapes for this family.

minimumAxes.rationale: A bare case count is satisfied by five copies of the same near-miss and proves nothing about diversity. Staged at 2 immediately after #91 merged (the minimum then met by every family reading stable: gitlab-token, npm-token), per docs/specs/decisions/2026-09-21-measure-benign-axis-diversity.md's ratchet plan. Raised to 3 once #93 (#90's part A3) authored the missing placeholder/reference axes for the 23 families that previously carried only a same-axis near-miss pair, plus one reference control each for gitlab-token and npm-token so the ratchet lands with zero regressions; measured via `npm run eval:classify` immediately before this value changed.

falseAlarms.rationale: A false alarm on a benign control is a recorded false positive; stable tolerates none.

criticalFailures.rationale: A metamorphic invariant violation (for example, detection lost after an envelope-preserving transform) shows the detector is not robust to construction, independent of how many cases were run.

unresolvedCritical.rationale: An unresolved critical mutation finding is a fixture-versus-detector disagreement nobody has reviewed yet; tier or sample size cannot substitute for that review.

unresolvedContractDisagreements.rationale: An unresolved disagreement with a peer scanner over what the provider contract requires means the contract itself may be wrong; stable requires it settled.

provisional.rationale: A family with at least one registered detector is useful even before its evidence clears every stable floor; provisional records that gap honestly instead of rounding up to stable.

pending.rationale: Tier T0 means no positive fixture has cleared review yet, so nothing about detection accuracy can be claimed for this family; pending is the only honest label.

unsupported.rationale: A family this project explicitly does not detect must record why, so the absence reads as a decision rather than an oversight. Without a reason, a family with no detector reports pending instead.
